summary: Two Texas hikers (26F, 31M) drifted off the East Ridge Trail in a snowstorm and became cliffed out about 800 vertical feet below the Quandary Peak summit; 13-hour extraction involving 18 rescuers
notes: Started hike 7 am Friday Aug 3; rescued Saturday morning; pair were unprepared for deteriorating weather Run 509 UN merge (URL opened this run; cites Vail Daily): the pair (woman 26, man 31) intended the East Ridge but mistakenly took the more technical West Ridge, turned back ~800 ft below the summit as snow fell, and got stuck above a cliff band; technical team could not reach them, so a Flight for Life helicopter located them at 4:47 p.m.; early-stage hypothermia slowed the 13-hour extraction.
